body:
In `src/components/dashboard/global-search-command.tsx`, the `Cmd/Ctrl+1`-`5` handler indexes the flat `results` array, while the on-screen number badges are assigned against `groupOrder`, which re-flattens in a different order (Quick Actions first, then residents, houses, payments, security, documents).

Once Quick Actions plus grouped results exceed 5 items, the badge and the shortcut disagree, so pressing `Cmd+3` navigates somewhere other than the item labelled 3.

Fix: derive both the badge numbers and the hotkey target from the same rendered order.

title: Cmd+1-5 search shortcuts jump to the wrong result
